description: An image library: upload, folders, a picker for other forms, and the usages that keep an image in use from being deleted (media.md).
by_hand: composer require intervention/image:^4 (it needs PHP's gd extension)

Route the library for signed-in users in routes/web.php, beside audit-entries in the auth group (not verified, so the policies alone decide who gets in): Route::resource('media-folders', MediaFolderController::class)->only(['store', 'update', 'destroy']); Route::post('media-items/move', MediaItemBulkMoveController::class)->name('media-items.bulk-move'); Route::resource('media-items', MediaItemController::class)->only(['index', 'store', 'update', 'destroy'])
php artisan storage:link, so the public disk serves the images

php artisan kit:import, then put the library in the menu: give .kit/structure/http/MediaItem.json "menu": {"title": "media-items.title", "icon": "images", "description": "media-items.menu_description"} (or "menu": null to keep it out) and run php artisan kit:apply
php artisan wayfinder:generate --with-form, then your package manager's build, which the library's Feature tests need

Decide who keeps the library: app/Policies/MediaItemPolicy.php and MediaFolderPolicy.php let every user with a verified email in until you change them, and mediaLibraryManager() / mediaLibraryOutsider() in tests/Helpers/MediaLibrary.php change with them
